lines.text: Ever feel like everyone is staring at you?
Psychologists call it the spotlight effect.
In one study, students wore an embarrassing T-shirt into a full room.
lines.say: In one study, students wore an embarrassing tee shirt into a full room.

lines.text: They guessed half the room noticed.
The real number? About a quarter.
Everyone else is busy starring in their own movie.
So relax. Nobody's watching as closely as you think.

post.title: Why It Feels Like Everyone's Watching You #shorts
